description: Federal Elections Analysis published race calls and persistent election-night control state. NBC projections publish only through the configured grace/override workflow; manual FEA calls remain authoritative.

_howToUse.candidateNameRule: Candidate names must match the candidate name in data/live-results.json exactly. Use raceIdGuide below to find the race, then copy the candidate name exactly.

statusOptions.winner: Use for a final or certain single-winner call. Label shown: Winner.
statusOptions.projected: Use for a single-winner projection before the result is final. Label shown: Projected winner.
statusOptions.advances: Use for top-two/open-primary candidates who are projected to advance. Label shown: Advances.
statusOptions.advanced: Use when a top-two/open-primary advance is final. Label shown: Advanced to general election.

_howToUse.optionalLabel: You can add a custom label field to any call if exact wording is needed.
_howToUse.optionalCalledAt: Add calledAt in ISO format. The OBS overlay uses this to decide which call is newest.
_howToUse.obsOverlay: For livestreams, add call-overlay.html as an OBS Browser Source. Suggested size: 1920x300, transparent background enabled. It checks this file automatically.
_howToUse.important: Use the authenticated election-night admin for calls, holds and overrides. Do not manually add a candidate unless FEA is intentionally calling that race. Historical primary calls remain archived in this file; general-election automation uses the current catalogue.
_howToUse.automaticCalls: NBC source, callState, publishAt and manualOverride are managed by the control service. Return to NBC auto through the admin to clear an override.
